issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (returns a double), but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int. This mismatch could confuse students about the expected return type and cause tests or usage that expect a double to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent with the UML/problem statement by changing the method signature in the template and solution to return double. Implement the calculation using double arithmetic (e.g., (double)getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors()) to avoid integer division.
